args.subject: Please confirm whether the window lock work has been done
args.body: Hi Perrin, our contractor (Keypath Repairs) has told us the lock work at Unit 2, 18 Brindlewick Mews, Orellin ZZ1 1ZZ was completed on Friday 19 September. We have no visit record, so we need to check with you. Can you tell us: (1) did anyone attend or gain access, and if so on what date? (2) Do the bathroom sash, bedroom sash and kitchen sash now open, lock and have working keys? Photos would help. If anything is still not fixed, please tell us and we will follow it up. Thank you.

args.subject: Lock work completion details and invoice needed - Unit 2, 18 Brindlewick Mews, Orellin ZZ1 1ZZ
args.body: Hi Edrin, following our calls, please send in writing for the lock job at Unit 2, 18 Brindlewick Mews, Orellin ZZ1 1ZZ: the invoice, the date and time of the visit, how you gained access (on 17 September you said you had not collected management keys), a description of the work done on each sash (bathroom, bedroom, kitchen) and any completion photos. The landlord has authorised the work but no spending limit or quote is on file, so please include a breakdown of costs. We cannot process anything until we have these.

args.reason: Waiting for Tenant confirmation of attendance/work and Contractor's invoice and completion evidence; escalate if still contradictory.

args.summary: Contractor Edrin (Keypath) claims lock work was completed 19 Sep but there is no invoice, appointment or attendance record. I asked the tenant to confirm attendance and outcome, asked the contractor for invoice and completion evidence, and set a follow-up for 29 Sep.
facts: Landlord authorised the agency's own provider, with no spending limit (event 3).
Provider changed from Hearthline to Keypath on 11 Sep (events 12-13).
Tenant offered Thu 18 Sep 08:30-10:30 and asked for management keys (events 17, 19).
On 17 Sep Edrin said three attempts failed and no management keys were collected (event 22).
On 22 Sep Edrin said the work was completed Fri 19 Sep and the invoice would come 26 Sep (event 23).
On 25 Sep Edrin again promised the invoice, but nothing is on file (events 24, 25).
conflicts: Edrin says the work was done on 19 Sep, but on 17 Sep he said he had no keys and had not met the tenant, and there is no appointment or attendance record (events 22-25).
The tenant has not confirmed any visit or fix.
missing: Tenant confirmation that the locks work
options_rejected: Escalate now: the tenant's confirmation could settle the contradiction.
Close the case or forward an invoice: there is no invoice and no evidence the work was done.
Wait only: both parties can be asked directly now.
args.uncertainty: It is unclear whether the work was done at all. If the tenant denies it or the contractor does not respond, escalate to the property manager.
